entries.claim: MIMO'S OWN DERIVED CALCULATION (not stated by any single source): using Runway's vendor-confirmed Gen-4.5 rate (12 credits/second) against its vendor-confirmed per-tier dollar-per-credit cost, Runway's per-second price ranges from ~$0.096/sec (Max, annual) up to ~$0.288/sec (Standard, monthly) depending on plan and billing cycle. Kling 3.0's only available per-second figure is a single third-party author's own derived estimate of ~$0.10/second (not vendor-confirmed). Finished per-clip math: a 5-second clip costs Kling ~$0.50 (estimated) versus Runway ~$0.48 (Max annual) to ~$1.44 (Standard monthly); a 10-second clip costs Kling ~$1.00 (estimated) versus Runway ~$0.96 to ~$2.88 across the same tier range.

honesty_notes: THE MOAT FINDING: no page in this page's entire competitive set (9 pages deep-fetched across this page's own same-day Phase 1 competitor audit) finishes this math. tomsguide.com hands readers the raw ingredients ($92/8,000 credits, 70 credits per 10-second Kling clip) but never multiplies them out; techsifted.com and selecthub.com attempt none. This entry is the completed version.

ASYMMETRIC CONFIDENCE, MUST BE STATED ON THE PAGE: the Runway side rests on TWO vendor-primary figures (EV-runway-review-01, runway.com/pricing, captured 2026-08-29; EV-runway-review-06, docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing/, captured 2026-08-29). The Kling side rests on ONE third-party author's own derived estimate (EV-best-ai-video-generators-19, curionic.net, June 2026, explicitly the author's own calculation, not a vendor-quoted rate). Kling publishes NO vendor-confirmed per-second rate anywhere found across 3 separate sweeps of this cluster -- klingai.com/pricing has returned HTTP 446 on 4 confirmed attempts (hub sweep 2026-08-10, kling-ai-review sweep 2026-08-17 x2, and this page's own 1-keyword.json/1-competitor.json notes). Do not present both sides of this math as equally sourced.

Uses CURRENT-version-to-current-version figures only: Runway's flagship Gen-4.5 (12 credits/sec, EV-runway-review-06's vendor-confirmed figure -- NOT eesel.ai's older, disputed 25-credits/sec figure, EV-runway-review-07) against Kling's flagship 3.0 (the version curionic.net's own June 2026 test names). This deliberately avoids the version-mismatch trap this page's whole competitive set falls into (3 of 9 competitor pages independently test/describe a stale Runway generation).

Full worked math for the writer's reference (annual billing): Standard $12/mo / 625 credits = $0.0192/credit x 12 credits/sec = $0.230/sec. Pro $28/mo / 2,250 credits = $0.01244/credit x 12 = $0.149/sec. Max $76/mo / 9,500 credits = $0.008/credit x 12 = $0.096/sec. Monthly (non-annual) billing runs roughly 20-25% higher per tier ($15/$35/$95 in place of $12/$28/$76).

Notable finding worth surfacing on the page: Runway's cheapest per-second rate (Max, annual, ~$0.096/sec) sits almost exactly AT Kling's ~$0.10/sec estimate -- the popular 'Kling is always cheaper' framing (repeated by techsifted.com and fahimai.com, both EV-kling-ai-vs-runway-03/-05) only holds clearly at Runway's Standard tier, not at Max. Do not repeat the flat 'Kling wins on price' framing without this tier caveat.

Two independent third-party sources corroborate with matching specifics: techsifted.com (2026-09-07) states 'If you subscribe to Runway Pro, you can actually use Kling's model within the Runway platform'; toolixlab.com (2026-06-14) states 'Every paid plan now includes access to Kling 3.0 Pro, Veo 3 and 3.1, Seedance 2.0, and multiple image generation models' and, more specifically, 'As of 2026, all Runway paid plans (Standard and above) include access to Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0 Pro, and Seedance 2.0 as third-party models.'

TIMING NOTE: fahimai.com (last modified 2026-05-12, independently fetched by this curator this run specifically to check this claim) describes Runway as offering 'over 30 creative AI tools' with ZERO mention of any third-party model bundling -- all described as Runway's own products. This is consistent with the bundling feature having been added to Runway sometime between May and June 2026 (toolixlab.com's June 14, 2026 date is the earliest confirmation found this run). Do not present this as something Runway has 'always' offered -- date it.

Runway's own page does NOT state a separate credit-cost for generating with Kling inside Runway versus using Runway's own Gen-4.5/Gen-4-Turbo models -- unconfirmed whether Kling-inside-Runway draws from the same credit pool at the same 12-credits/sec rate or a different one. MATERIAL IMPACT ON THE 'CAN YOU USE BOTH?' PAA this page is expected to answer: a reader does not strictly need two separate subscriptions to access both models' output -- a single Runway Standard-or-above subscription includes Kling 3.0 Pro access. This does NOT make the tools equivalent (Kling-inside-Runway is gated behind Runway's own UI, credit system, and generation limits, not Kling's native app or pricing) -- the honest answer changes from 'you need two separate subscriptions' to 'you can reach Kling's model through one Runway subscription, with tradeoffs neither vendor documents in detail.'

Runway's own product page does not attribute Kling to its developer (no Kuaishou mention) -- it lists Kling generically alongside other third-party models 'from Google, OpenAI, Kling, ByteDance and more.' Mimo's own already-registered Kuaishou/Beijing ownership finding (EV-kling-ai-review-11) still applies regardless of which platform surfaces the model.
